description: Grace Engineering - whole-shop view. Which machines are up, which are cutting, and what stopped when. Native Grafana panels only (no AngularJS plugins).

panels.description: Counts across all machines, from each machine's last known Availability / Execution / EmergencyStop value.

targets.rawSql:
-- one row of fleet counters, from each machine's last known state.
-- get_last_value(path, search_limit) returns (time, value) - see
-- services/relay/src/migrations/versions/023-get_last_value2.sql
SELECT
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.value = 'AVAILABLE')                            AS "Online",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.value = 'ACTIVE')                               AS "Cutting",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.value = 'AVAILABLE'
                     AND e.value IS DISTINCT FROM 'ACTIVE')                AS "Idle",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.value = 'TRIGGERED')                            AS "E-Stop"
FROM devices d
LEFT JOIN LATERAL get_last_value(d.path || '/Availability', '7d')              a ON true
LEFT JOIN LATERAL get_last_value(d.path || '/Controller/Path/Execution', '7d') e ON true
LEFT JOIN LATERAL get_last_value(d.path || '/Controller/EmergencyStop', '7d')  s ON true
WHERE d.path NOT LIKE '%/Host'

panels.title: Fleet at a Glance

panels.description: Last known state of every machine. Click a machine name to open the Machine dashboard for it.

targets.rawSql:
-- last known state of every machine (the host box is excluded).
-- "path" is hidden in the panel - it only feeds the drilldown data link.
SELECT
  d.path                     AS "path",
  split_part(d.path, '/', 2) AS "Machine",
  a.value                    AS "Availability",
  e.value                    AS "Execution",
  m.value                    AS "Mode",
  p.value                    AS "Program",
  e.time                     AS "State since"
FROM devices d
LEFT JOIN LATERAL get_last_value(d.path || '/Availability', '7d')                  a ON true
LEFT JOIN LATERAL get_last_value(d.path || '/Controller/Path/Execution', '7d')     e ON true
LEFT JOIN LATERAL get_last_value(d.path || '/Controller/Path/ControllerMode', '7d') m ON true
LEFT JOIN LATERAL get_last_value(d.path || '/Controller/Path/ProgramMain', '7d')   p ON true
WHERE d.path NOT LIKE '%/Host'
ORDER BY d.path

panels.title: Availability - is the machine talking to us?

panels.description: Availability / Execution / ControllerMode / EmergencyStop changes across the whole shop, newest first.

targets.rawSql:
-- every state change across the shop, newest first -
-- this is the "what stopped, and when?" panel.
SELECT
  time                                          AS "Time",
  split_part(device, '/', 2)                    AS "Machine",
  substring(path, '^[^/]+/[^/]+/(.*)')          AS "Item",
  value                                         AS "State"
FROM history_text
WHERE $__timeFilter("time")
  AND device NOT LIKE '%/Host'
  AND (   path LIKE '%/Availability'
       OR path LIKE '%/Execution'
       OR path LIKE '%/ControllerMode'
       OR path LIKE '%/EmergencyStop' )
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 300

panels.title: Recent State Changes

panels.description: Seconds since the last observation of any kind was stored for each machine. Anything pinned at 300s is not sending data.

targets.rawSql:
-- seconds since the relay last stored ANY observation for each machine.
-- the 5 minute bound keeps this cheap - a machine with no data in that window
-- pins at 300s, which is the "no data getting through" signal.
SELECT
  split_part(d.path, '/', 2)                              AS "Machine",
  coalesce(extract(epoch FROM (now() - f.last_seen)), 300) AS "Age"
FROM devices d
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT max(h.time) AS last_seen
  FROM history_all h
  WHERE h.device = d.path
    AND h.time > now() - interval '5 minutes'
) f ON true
WHERE d.path NOT LIKE '%/Host'
ORDER BY 1
